@gideon.sato: the first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, your post in this channel saying the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan.

The only guard activity in the channel is from that same 10:42 post: the guard was "writing trailer numbers on a clipboard." Later, Mateo reported at 11:03 that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Nothing in the channel says what the guard did between those points. For that you'd need the guard's shift log or whoever was at the gate.
